title: monardella odoratissima var. pinetorum
intro: Monardella odoratissima var. pinetorum, commonly known as Pine Mountain monardella, is a fragrant shrub belonging to the Lamiaceae family, native to the southwestern United States. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, helping to soothe wounds, reduce pain, and combat infections. The therapeutic actions of Pine Mountain monardella include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress, and promote relaxation, making it a valuable remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Pine Mountain monardella include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
